calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --host dev --worktree --json
mu task claim s1 -w eval --for w1
mu task close s1 -w eval --evidence 's1 will be done on dev'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do s1; mu is not on this host'
out=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval); rev=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; mu agent collect w1 -w eval
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi
mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --host dev --worktree --json
mu task claim s2 -w eval --for w1
mu task close s2 -w eval --evidence 's2 will be done on dev'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do s2; mu is not on this host'
out=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval); rev=$(echo "$out" | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$rev" ] && mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; mu agent collect w1 -w eval
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi

text: s1 and s2 ran on dev and are on main.
